# ISecuritizeArkErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/arks/ISecuritizeArkErrors.sol)


## Errors
### InvalidTargetWallet
Reverts when the constructor or `setCustodianWallet` is given the zero address.


```solidity
error InvalidTargetWallet();
```

### InvalidOracleAddress
Reverts when the constructor is given a zero oracle address.


```solidity
error InvalidOracleAddress();
```

### InvalidShareTokenAddress
Reverts when the constructor is given a zero share-token address.


```solidity
error InvalidShareTokenAddress();
```

### InvalidRegistryAddress
Reverts when the registry service resolved from the DSToken is the zero address
(i.e. the token has no registry configured).


```solidity
error InvalidRegistryAddress();
```

### MustRequireKeeperData
Reverts when the Ark is deployed without `requiresKeeperData = true`; the on-ramp
subscription payload is supplied as keeper board data, so it is mandatory.


```solidity
error MustRequireKeeperData();
```

### TransferNotCompliant
Reverts when a prospective DSToken transfer fails the compliance pre-check.


```solidity
error TransferNotCompliant(uint256 code, string reason);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`code`|`uint256`|The non-zero compliance failure code returned by `preTransferCheck`|
|`reason`|`string`|The human-readable reason returned by `preTransferCheck`|

### OraclePriceNotPositive
Reverts when the NAV oracle returns a non-positive answer.


```solidity
error OraclePriceNotPositive();
```

### StaleOraclePrice
Reverts when the oracle's `updatedAt` is older than `ORACLE_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT`.


```solidity
error StaleOraclePrice();
```

### PendingWithdrawalActive
Reverts when `requestWithdrawal` is called while a withdrawal cycle is already in
flight (`pendingWithdrawalShares > 0`).


```solidity
error PendingWithdrawalActive();
```

### ArkIsFrozen
Reverts when a state-changing entry point is invoked while the ark is frozen via
`setArkFrozen`.


```solidity
error ArkIsFrozen();
```

### InvalidDepositSlippage
Reverts when `setDepositSlippage` or the constructor is given a value above
`MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE`.


```solidity
error InvalidDepositSlippage(Percentage newSlippage, Percentage maxSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newSlippage`|`Percentage`|The rejected slippage value|
|`maxSlippage`|`Percentage`|The maximum allowed slippage (`MAX_DEPOSIT_SLIPPAGE`)|

### InvalidSweepSlippage
Reverts when `setSweepSlippage` or the constructor is given a value above
`MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE`.


```solidity
error InvalidSweepSlippage(Percentage newSlippage, Percentage maxSlippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newSlippage`|`Percentage`|The rejected slippage value|
|`maxSlippage`|`Percentage`|The maximum allowed slippage (`MAX_SWEEP_SLIPPAGE`)|

### InvalidSubscriptionFeeTolerance
Reverts when `setSubscriptionFeeTolerance` is given a value above
`MAX_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE`.


```solidity
error InvalidSubscriptionFeeTolerance(Percentage newTolerance, Percentage maxTolerance);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newTolerance`|`Percentage`|The rejected tolerance value|
|`maxTolerance`|`Percentage`|The maximum allowed tolerance (`MAX_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE`)|

### InsufficientAssetsReturned
Reverts in `sweep` when the base asset returned by Securitize is below the asset
value snapshotted at `requestWithdrawal` time minus `sweepSlippage`.


```solidity
error InsufficientAssetsReturned(uint256 receivedAssets, uint256 expectedAssets);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receivedAssets`|`uint256`|The base-asset balance held at sweep time|
|`expectedAssets`|`uint256`|The asset value requested at `requestWithdrawal` time|

### DisembarkDisabled
Reverts when `disembark`/`move` is attempted with a nonzero amount — this Ark exits
only via the async `requestWithdrawal`/`sweep` cycle, never synchronous disembark.


```solidity
error DisembarkDisabled();
```

### SharesNotArrived
Reverts in `_board` when the DSTokens minted by the on-ramp subscription are below
the oracle-implied expected shares minus `depositSlippage` and
`subscriptionFeeTolerance` (NAV-source divergence or excess on-ramp fee).


```solidity
error SharesNotArrived(uint256 expectedShares, uint256 actualNewShares);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`expectedShares`|`uint256`|Oracle-implied shares for the boarded amount|
|`actualNewShares`|`uint256`|Shares actually minted to this Ark by the subscription|

### OnRampNotConfigured
Reverts when the DSToken has no on-ramp registered under service id 16384.


```solidity
error OnRampNotConfigured();
```

### OnRampAssetMismatch
Reverts when the resolved on-ramp's liquidity token does not match this Ark's base
asset (e.g. a re-registered on-ramp), since `_board` approves/passes the base asset.


```solidity
error OnRampAssetMismatch(address expected, address actual);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`expected`|`address`|This Ark's configured base asset|
|`actual`|`address`|The on-ramp's liquidity token|

### InvalidSubscriptionPayload
Reverts when the keeper-supplied subscription payload is malformed, targets a
destination other than the resolved on-ramp, uses a non-`subscribe` selector, mints
to a wallet other than THIS Ark, or encodes an amount other than the boarded amount.


```solidity
error InvalidSubscriptionPayload();
```
